columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.reason: No Selection. SIG-20260918-002 and SIG-20260918-003 expose strong governance mechanisms around turn-scoped authority snapshots and immutable approval-to-invocation binding, but each currently rests primarily on one maintainer implementation and overlaps recent authority-at-action-time work from September 2 and September 12. SIG-20260918-005 provides strong primary evidence that low spontaneous harm can coexist with high conditional contagion once an unsafe trajectory crosses an unintended communication boundary, but promoting it today would create material semantic concentration with the September 17 Emergence World object on cross-agent propagation, containment and recovery of harmful state. All three remain valuable candidates; none is selected merely to fill the Digital Employee slot.
columns.reason_zh: No Selection。SIG-20260918-002 与 SIG-20260918-003 分别提供 Turn-scoped Authority Snapshot 与不可变 Approval-to-invocation Binding 的强治理机制，但当前各自仍主要依赖单一 Maintainer Implementation，并与 9 月 2 日、9 月 12 日围绕 Action-time Authority 的既有研究较为接近。SIG-20260918-005 则提供强一手证据，说明自然发生的伤害率很低，并不等于系统在不安全 Trajectory 穿过非预期 Communication Boundary 后的条件传播风险也低；但今天若再次选入，会与 9 月 17 日 Emergence World 关于有害状态跨 Agent 传播、Containment 与 Recovery 的对象形成明显 Semantic Concentration。因此三者均保留为 Candidate，本栏不为填满名额而强选。
columns.next: Retain SIG-20260918-002, SIG-20260918-003 and SIG-20260918-005 as candidates for future cross-sample work on authority epochs, immutable call approval and conditional multi-agent contagion. Reading must perform no separate Digital Employee Deep Reading for this run.
columns.next_zh: 保留 SIG-20260918-002、SIG-20260918-003 与 SIG-20260918-005 为 Candidate，等待未来围绕 Authority Epoch、Immutable Call Approval 与条件性 Multi-Agent Contagion 的跨样本研究；本轮 Reading 不得为 Digital Employee 单独执行 Deep Reading。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: Shared multi-agent coordination rules need pre-execution robustness guarantees under stochastic rewards
columns.title_zh: 共享 Multi-Agent 协调规则在随机奖励环境中需要执行前 Robustness Guarantee
columns.source_zh: Social Laws 一手研究：把共享协调约束扩展到随机、基于 Reward 的 Multi-Agent Environment，并用 alpha-robustness 与 MDP Reduction 验证个体最低保留效用
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260918-007 after Skill 02 triage. Social Laws supplies a bounded architecture question that remains meaningful without the paper name: a coordination rule that appears acceptable in deterministic demonstrations may still impose unacceptable outcomes when execution is stochastic and each agent optimizes its own reward. The primary study defines alpha-robustness as a minimum retained-utility guarantee under a shared social law and reduces verification to a series of Markov decision processes. The Industry Architecture question is therefore how admissible interaction constraints should be specified and verified before execution so coordination safety is not inferred from observed success alone. This is distinct from the September 14 CoCoBench object, which decomposed coordination competence into allocation, ordering, mutual exclusion and handoff for measurement, and from the September 11 UnitBoost object, which asked when deterministic operators can replace generative managers. Today's object studies ex-ante robustness guarantees for a shared coordination policy under stochastic outcomes.
columns.reason_zh: 经 Skill 02 筛选后选自 SIG-20260918-007。Social Laws 提供了一个去掉论文名称仍成立的有界架构问题：一条在确定性演示中看似可接受的协调规则，在执行具有随机性且每个 Agent 都优化自身 Reward 时，仍可能给个体造成不可接受的结果。该一手研究把 alpha-robustness 定义为共享 Social Law 下个体最低保留效用保证，并把验证约化为一系列 Markov Decision Process。因而 Industry Architecture 的问题是：执行前应如何描述并验证允许的 Interaction Constraint，使系统不再从观察到的成功直接推导协调安全。它与 9 月 14 日 CoCoBench 对象不同，后者把协调能力拆成 Allocation、Ordering、Mutual Exclusion 与 Handoff 分别测量；也不同于 9 月 11 日 UnitBoost 对象，后者研究何时可用确定性 Operator 替代生成式 Manager。今天单独研究随机结果下共享协调 Policy 的 Ex-ante Robustness Guarantee。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the formal social-law definition, stochastic reward model, alpha-robustness semantics, MDP reduction and verification procedure, computational assumptions, experiments or examples, comparison with deterministic social-law formulations, sensitivity to agent policies and reward structure, failure cases, scalability and limits. It must not infer production-safe coordination from formal guarantees whose environment model omits relevant states, actions or external effects.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 Social Law 的形式化定义、随机 Reward Model、alpha-robustness 语义、MDP Reduction 与 Verification Procedure、计算假设、实验或示例、与确定性 Social-law Formulation 的比较、对 Agent Policy 与 Reward Structure 的敏感性、Failure Case、Scalability 与边界；不得从遗漏关键 State、Action 或 External Effect 的环境模型所给出的形式保证，直接推导生产环境协调安全。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.title: Long-running tool execution should expose bounded progress telemetry instead of forcing the runtime to guess
columns.title_zh: 长时间 Tool Execution 应暴露有界进度遥测，而不是让 Runtime 猜测完成时间
columns.source_zh: Ask the Tool, Don't Guess 一手研究：从正在运行的 Tool 暴露 Remaining-work / Near-completion Signal，在不改变 Agent 语义上下文的情况下改善 Serving 与资源调度
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260918-006 as the strongest Open-source Engineering object. The study isolates a runtime observability problem: pre-call duration estimates are inherently stale at the moment a long-running tool is actually progressing, while the tool execution layer may already know remaining work or near-completion state. Its harness exposes bounded progress signals outside the agent-visible semantic context and reports roughly 20.7% and 20.8% reductions in p90 post-tool-call TTFT versus LRU in the reported HBM-only and HBM-plus-DRAM settings. The bounded engineering question is what machine-observable progress contract the execution layer should publish to scheduling and recovery logic, how much decision value it adds, and how to keep operational telemetry separate from business semantics. This is distinct from the September 16 Skill Routing object, which studied how to choose capabilities as catalogs grow, and from long-horizon completion research, which asks whether required business actions were actually completed; today's object studies runtime telemetry while a tool is still executing.
columns.reason_zh: 作为本日 Open-source Engineering 中最强的 Research Object，选自 SIG-20260918-006。该研究隔离出一个 Runtime Observability 问题：调用前的 Duration Estimate 在长时间 Tool 真正执行过程中天然会变旧，而 Tool Execution Layer 往往已经知道 Remaining Work 或 Near-completion State。其 Harness 在不改变 Agent-visible Semantic Context 的前提下暴露有界 Progress Signal，并在所报告的 HBM-only 与 HBM + DRAM 设置中，相对 LRU 将 Tool Call 后 p90 TTFT 分别降低约 20.7% 与 20.8%。因此有界工程问题是：Execution Layer 应向 Scheduling / Recovery Logic 发布怎样的 Machine-observable Progress Contract，这些信号能增加多少决策价值，以及怎样把 Operational Telemetry 与 Business Semantics 分开。它与 9 月 16 日 Skill Routing 对象不同，后者研究 Skill Catalog 扩大时如何选择能力；也不同于长周期 Completion 研究，后者研究业务要求是否真正完成。今天单独研究 Tool 仍在执行期间的 Runtime Telemetry。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the progress-signal definitions, harness instrumentation, whether signals are remaining-work, near-completion or both, serving integration, HBM-only and HBM-plus-DRAM configurations, LRU and predictor baselines, the reported p90 TTFT calculations, decision timing, overhead, calibration under environment change, failure cases, semantic-isolation claim and generalization beyond the evaluated tool workloads. It must separate better scheduling information from any claim that progress telemetry proves business completion or authorizes retry.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 Progress Signal 定义、Harness Instrumentation、信号究竟是 Remaining-work、Near-completion 还是两者兼有、Serving Integration、HBM-only 与 HBM + DRAM 配置、LRU / Predictor Baseline、所报告 p90 TTFT 的计算、Decision Timing、Overhead、环境变化下的 Calibration、Failure Case、Semantic Isolation 主张以及被评估 Tool Workload 之外的泛化边界；必须把更好的 Scheduling Information 与‘Progress Telemetry 可以证明 Business Completion 或授权 Retry’严格分开。
